item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The diagram shows Alok's ray. It starts at point $D$ and passes through points $E$ and $F$ in that order.

Which label correctly names the ray?

options.A: Ray $DE$ or ray $DF$, because the starting point $D$ comes first, then a point on the path.
options.B: Ray $ED$, because $E$ and $D$ both lie on the path.
options.C: Point $D$ is produced by the ray, so any letter order is fine.
options.D: Line $DEF$, treating the path as a two-way line with no starting point.
